title: Cowaltz
blurb: A knight with an egg shield, a fairy princess with a bow and the trooper with his huge ball gun defend a blue moon. Bees aim, then launch themselves stinger-first; bounce them into each other for ricochet chains. Every sting costs an EpiPen.
controls: Stick to move; Knight: BASH (shield bounces bees back); Fairy: hold SHOOT; Trooper: hold FIRE; tap a hero or their portrait to switch, the others are AI
